sections.title: Journeys
sections.sql: select * from journey_health order by code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from attention_queue order by kind,reference

sections.title: Decide next
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,priority_score,current_evidence from priority_queue where state in ('proposed','approved') order by priority_score desc,code

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.sql: select j.code as journey,s.position,s.name,s.channel,s.customer_action,s.pain,s.owner from steps s join journeys j on j.id=s.journey_id order by j.code,s.position,s.id
